scope: Pre-fix production short startup checks on 118 local reference games and 12 new Gamerias. Static and first-level network success does not certify gameplay.
limitations: Some missing iframes were caused by headless graphics resource exhaustion; retest in fresh sessions
External ads, analytics and gameplay dependencies may have runtime network errors
External provider frames and old puzzle games not rerun in this sweep
Sanitized output excludes user tokens and query strings
